references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species shape: tall vampire lord, dark crimson-and-black robe, high stiff collar, staff.

prompt_fields.subject: A tall vampiric lord in flowing dark crimson-and-black robes with a high stiff collar framing a pale gaunt face, standing upright and imperious, gripping a long dark ornate staff planted at his side. LIGHTNESS REQUIREMENT (48px dark-floor and grayscale readability): the first attempt's robe was near-black and read as a dark column in grayscale, close to the Pale Drake's dark robe. Redraw the robe in a clearly LIGHTER mid-value: saturated crimson-red main planes (not near-black), broad ivory-white trim, high collar lining and sash, pale skin, so the figure is visibly lighter than the disc and its grayscale value planes are distinct from a dark violet skeleton archmage. Keep the same upright columnar robed silhouette with the tall high collar, staff with red orb held on the LEFT of the picture.
prompt_fields.contrast: First undead/vampire catalog identity, no family collision. Distinct from the catalog's other robed humanoid casters (Fillarel's pale cream robe and Pale Drake's violet-black robe, both shipping in the same batch) by its deep crimson-and-black palette and stiff high-collared silhouette -- a commanding vampire-lord read, not a benign caster or a gaunt bone archmage. Silhouette (stiff high collar, imperious upright stance) and hue (deep crimson-black, the only red-black robed figure in the catalog) are the anchors.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep black robe with rich blood-crimson panels and a stiff high collar, pale gaunt vampiric skin at the face and hands, a dark iron-black ornate staff with a small dull red gem finial; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's robe so the two never merge.
